name: inbox
description: A side panel that keeps what a conversation leaves open: questions, your tasks, findings and unfinished asks

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How much of each turn the inbox reads. Light reads with Haiku: it costs less and misses more. Thorough reads far more of what Claude ran, changed and wrote: it costs more and misses less. Exhaustive also checks every subagent's report against what that subagent ran, with one more model call for each subagent.
